content:
Kelkoo Sales Tracking (KST) lets Kelkoo Group measure the sales your campaigns generate, and use that to optimise the traffic sent to your site.

Accurate sales data feeds Kelkoo Group's optimisation algorithms, which use it to work out which traffic sources, placements and offers perform best for your business.

topic: Privacy and consent: which tag needs consent
queries: does KST need user consent
which tag requires consent
do I need consent for the lead tag
does the conversion tag need consent
what is the legal basis for KST
consent requirements for Kelkoo tracking
CMP setup for KST
content:
KST is designed to minimise data collected and respect applicable privacy requirements. The two tags differ in their legal basis:

**Lead Tag** — requires appropriate user consent before setting first-party cookies or using equivalent browser storage. Users are identified by an anonymous identifier.

**Conversion Tag** — does not require separate user consent. Kelkoo Group relies on **legitimate interest** as the legal basis for processing the sales data needed to measure and optimise campaign performance.

Kelkoo Group only uses sales data relevant to measuring and optimising its campaigns, and does not collect information that directly identifies individual customers.

Full detail on data processing, cookies and your responsibilities as an advertiser is in the GDPR Notice for Kelkoo Sales Tracking, the Kelkoo Group Privacy Policy and the Kelkoo Group Cookie Policy.

content:
For the most accurate tracking, Kelkoo Group recommends implementing **both**:

- Google Tag Manager (GTM) tracking
- Server-to-server integration

Where possible these should run in parallel, to maximise tracking coverage and accuracy.

Other installation methods are available for sites on specific ecommerce platforms or with custom technical setups — see the Installation Methods page to pick the right one for your website.

topic: How the kk parameter and first-party identifier work
queries: what is the kk parameter
how does KST identify a Kelkoo visit
what is the kelkooId
why is the identifier first party
how does KST link a click to a purchase
how does the lead tag store the identifier
content:
A Kelkoo click carries a unique identifier in the **kk** URL parameter. The Lead Tag reads that identifier and, once the required consent has been obtained, stores it in first-party browser storage.

Because the identifier is stored on *your* domain rather than a Kelkoo Group domain, it counts as first-party. Storing it this way lets KST recognise the original Kelkoo visit if the user comes back later and buys.

The Conversion Tag then fires on every completed order and sends the transaction information Kelkoo Group needs — Order ID, Order Value, the Kelkoo identifier where available, and any further detail your implementation supplies. The tag should fire for every completed order regardless of which channel brought the user back for the final visit; Kelkoo Group applies its own attribution logic afterwards.

topic: Attribution model: Kelkoo Channel Last Click
queries: how does KST attribution work
what attribution model does Kelkoo use
do I get credit if a customer converts through another channel later
will I still get the sale if someone clicks elsewhere before buying
who gets credit for the sale when multiple channels are involved
why do my numbers differ from Google Analytics
last click attribution
content:
KST uses a **Kelkoo Channel Last Click** attribution model with a **30-day conversion window**.

When a user clicks a Kelkoo Group ad, KST stores the identifier for that visit. If the same user buys within the next 30 days, the sale can be attributed to Kelkoo Group — and that still holds if the user returns via a different channel before purchasing.

Worked example from the documentation:

- Day 1: user clicks a Kelkoo Group ad, visits your site, does not purchase
- Day 5: user returns via organic Google search, does not purchase
- Day 10: user returns directly and completes a purchase

KST attributes that sale to Kelkoo Group, because the user clicked through Kelkoo within the previous 30 days.

**Important:** this differs from how Google Analytics and similar platforms attribute. An analytics platform using cross-channel last-click might credit the example above to another channel. Such differences do not necessarily indicate a tracking problem — they follow from different attribution methodologies.

queries: what is the conversion window
how long is the KST attribution window
how long does the cookie last for attribution
how many days after a click does a sale still count
what happens after 30 days
what if the user clicks Kelkoo twice
content:
The KST conversion window is **30 days**. A transaction can be attributed to Kelkoo Group when it happens within 30 days of a qualifying Kelkoo click.

Once that 30-day period expires, the click is no longer considered for attribution.

If another Kelkoo click occurs during the window, the **most recent** qualifying Kelkoo click is the one used.

topic: Single-page apps (SPA) and tag performance FAQ
queries: does KST work on a single page application
do I need to fire the tag on every virtual page view
does KST slow down my site
KST performance impact
SPA compatibility for Kelkoo tracking
do I need to change the pixel for a React or Vue site
how many times should the lead tag load
content:
Answers from the documentation's FAQ:

**Does the tag need to load once, or on every virtual page view in an SPA?**
The Lead Tag exists to store the user ID from the `kk` query parameter into a first-party cookie, for correct attribution and measurement. It only needs to load **once**.

**Does injecting the tag on each virtual page load hurt performance?**
The tag loads a pixel asynchronously as a fallback for storing the user ID. Because it is asynchronous, it does not impact site performance.

**Is any SPA-specific optimisation or pixel change needed?**
No optimisation is needed for SPAs. Kelkoo Group does not track individual product pages viewed by the end user, and does not use this tag for retargeting.

GDPR notice for Kelkoo
content:
KST uses first-party cookies, in line with industry standards, set on your own domain.

For Kelkoo Group traffic sourced from Google, KST also calls a **Google Global Site Tag** to track conversions; that tag uses cookies to identify unique users.

If you use KST, Kelkoo Group suggests including the cookie information below (or equivalent) in your own cookie policy to notify users.

topic: What data KST processes, where it is stored, and who controls it
queries: what personal data does the tracking pixel collect

content:
Data processing details published by Kelkoo Group:

Info | Description
Technology partner | Kelkoo Group
Data Host | Kelkoo Group
Country of data storage | The Netherlands
Period of data storage | Raw data with timestamp: Clicks, tracking points and events: Indefinite Impressions: 30 days Aggregated data: Indefinite
List of processed and stored data | User ID Time of Interaction URL of Interaction IP address Location data User agent data Sales transaction data Transaction details (if supplied by merchant)
Description of processed and stored data | Transaction details stored are defined by merchant integration and can include Product Ids, basket value, product names etc
Goal/Objective of data storage | Report sales conversion for Kelkoo Group traffic to optimize campaigns.
Used technologies | HTML, JavaScript, Cookie
Fallback technologies | Local Storage Session Storage Third-party cookies
Cookie domain | Merchant domain name (for first party cookies) / Kelkoogroup.net (for third-party cookies)
Integration on which pages | LeadTag: all pages ConversionTag: "Thank you page" / Confirmation page
Integration type | Asynchronous JavaScript Tag

Kelkoo Group processes this data on its own behalf and is the **data controller** for GDPR purposes. That is independent of similar data you collect on your own behalf or via other partners, for which you or those partners remain controllers. There is no controller-processor relationship between Kelkoo Group and you.

Questions can go to your usual Kelkoo Group contact or to Kelkoo Group's Data Protection Officer at dpo@kelkoogroup.com
